# Proposed integrated qualification phases

No submission is performed by these scripts. Root must first converge alias canonicalization, frontend cleanup, metadata lifetime ea4209 and layout supplement ce4a7, seal the exact source, record its Git base and diff, and approve the private opt-in/capacity overlays. Production main stays closed.

1. Preflight the combined source with components/gate.sh FRESH_DIR LEGACY_SEED MODERN_RAW. The metadata IR component includes real arena reset, retired-address reuse, unknown binding refusal, native 128-byte stride canaries, page and budget controls. Component success is not BFS acceptance.
2. Submit bootstrap_snapshot.sh SEALED_SOURCE SOURCE_MANIFEST LEGACY_SEED FRESH_OUTPUT inside a single Slurm allocation (32 GiB, two CPUs, 45 minutes recommended from the prior build). The manifest must cover self-hosted, stdlib, scripts and all overlays. The recipe verifies source/seed before and after, rejects explicit bootstrap errors even at status 0, and publishes RAW_READY only after a clean ELF build. It does not apply overlays or mutate the shared worktree.
3. On that exact READY hash, run gate.sh ROOT_SNAPSHOT SEALED_SERVICES FRESH_OUT RAW_READY RAW under Slurm (4 GiB, one CPU, up to 45 minutes). It compiles the canonical C++23 runtime/oracle, then checks/compiles/runs imported direct, facade, homonym and hardlink-origin positives. Six semantic negatives each require checker and compiler refusal without ELF. Four actual canonical normal kernels are exercised through the real F64 pool with loop regions 0 and 1; the C++23 oracle checks 60 ordered rows, serial/worker bit identity and independent numeric references. Services owns its full fourteen-case matrix and application pipeline; those remain separate gates.
4. Retain every failure and distinguish source check, compilation, native execution, allowlist/ABI checks, numeric concordance and whole-stdlib results. No READY file or component result closes the public feature. Export source, seeds, ELF, logs, manifests and Slurm receipts durably after execution.

Preserved predecessor: raw11332, source root908f plus recorded opt-in/capacity overlays. Loader gate Slurm19394 reached imported direct check0 but compilation124 at600 seconds; later cases did not run. Services thread failed identity10/cap201 and pools timed out. Diagnostic NoReset removed the Worker metadata lifetime symptom but was not accepted as a fix. The serial normal control19364 passed60rows/two wrong-result controls with raw826d and no Worker capability; it is not a Worker runtime result.

The proposed bootstrap recipe has bash syntax validation only. It has not been submitted. The corrected imported Worker gate awaits the next integrated raw.
